gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, read at each maker's US store on 2026-11-27, the BLUETTI Elite 30 mini ($199) was the only AC-outlet station at or under $200 I found in stock at its maker: EcoFlow RIVER 2 (240) is $189 but unavailable, AFERIY P040 is $169 and unavailable (not the $119.90 ChatGPT showed), Anker SOLIX C300 is sold out and Jackery Explorer 300 v2 is $299.
standout_why: Compared against PowerSized (cited), The Inertia (cited), Watt & Warden, Radar of Products, MachineFanatic, RV Gear Lab and The Power Station Guide. PowerSized already has the Elite 30 mini at $199 (checked Nov 27, 7.3 lb) and the Jackery 300 v2 as sold out, so part of this exists; it prices nothing else under $250. The Inertia gives the RIVER 3 a $200 undated price. Watt & Warden prices only Amazon (Nov 26), calls the RIVER 2 'the only major-brand AC station under $200' and omits the Elite 30 mini. The other four list no per-model prices and no stock notices. None reads the whole class at the makers' stores with stock status, and none catches the AFERIY price and stock mismatch with ChatGPT's card. Held at 2, not 3, because the base EcoFlow RIVER 3 (ChatGPT's first-run pick at $179) could not be priced today.
decides: Confirms the Elite 30 mini as the pick among AC-outlet stations at $200 or less: 288 Wh for $199 in stock at the maker (Dealectric's table has $189.05 through our link), and under budget only at the sale price (list $249.99; BLUETTI sale runs to Nov 30 per the brief). It beats the RIVER 2 240 on capacity for $10 more (288 vs 243 Wh) and the RIVER 2 is unavailable at EcoFlow though $189 on Amazon. The VTOMAN Jump 600X at $199 on Amazon remains the only rival that may beat it, on AC watts (600 W in the listing title). The pick stays provisional against the RIVER 3 until its price is read. The TRAIL 300 DC is off the page (no AC outlet); the Jackery 300 v2 ($299), RIVER 2 256 Wh ($209 Amazon) and Tenergy T320 ($225.99 in the brief, not re-read) are just over the line.
